title: Research journal
intro: The new comparison does not support adding a learned gate. Small models, equal experts and the dense MoE all have negative mean forecast skill against their training-only prior. This is a bounded feasibility screen, not a convergence study or a new independent holdout.
auditTitle: Forward records: timing and score reconstruction
auditNote: This audit checks a fixed prefix of the ongoing observation chain. A few hours test the recording process; they cannot establish predictive value. Mature but unscored forecasts await later captures. The original publication snapshot below remains unchanged.
cashTitle: Why the earlier model stayed in cash
cashNote: Saved scores were inspected without refitting or choosing a new rule. The hourly price model never exceeded the fixed 20 bp hurdle in any original test fold. Its 99 th-percentile prediction was about 3.6–4.3 bp; even the four-hour model was mostly below 20 bp. Changing the hurdle changes participation; it does not repair weak forecasts.
modelNote: Four-hour bars, twelve-bar windows, seven price features, identical eligible dates and delayed entry. The 84-input Ridge baseline uses the same flattened window. Neural models use three fixed seeds and five epochs; weights are not assumed converged.39 fits completed in{seconds}seconds. No original screen was refitted.
policyNote: Each fold reserves the last 30 calendar days for validation. Training and validation label exits are purged before the next decision interval. Validation selects among 0/10/20 bp long/cash hurdles using 10 bp one-way costs; the choice is frozen before the test. Fixed 20 bp and 0/10/25 bp fee results are also retained. All test periods were already examined, so this remains retrospective exploration.
aggregationNote: Returns are medians over fold/seed cases, skills and asset-average holding-bar shares are means, and drawdown is the worst case. Fold/seed ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals or independent trials. Accounts start with equal initial capital per asset; folds are never stitched.
details: Inspect all 234 fold / seed / rule / cost cases
gatesTitle: Learned dense gate: nine fold/seed cases
gateNote: All three LSTMs process every window. Gate weights mix hidden representations; the weights do not prove independent forecasts or economic roles. Usage and entropy diagnose routing, not trading value.
providerTitle: What is known about the factor inputs
providerNote: Official public documentation confirms net sentiment (CO-A-02-03) and standardized sentiment deviation (CO-S-01-01). CO-S-01-05 remains unconfirmed in this review. Period open/close fields do not establish first publication, timezone or revision history. More granular advertised intervals do not change the daily grain of our retained snapshot.
nextNote: Let the bounded observer finish, then repeat the read-only audit. Extend the observation period only under a separately frozen protocol; do not change a running model after seeing scores. Obtain provider-owned publication/revision metadata before restarting historical factor claims. Longer training and sparse routing need new hypotheses and budgets, rather than selection from these test results.
sourcesNote: Aggregate-only explicit publication. Raw inputs, individual forecasts and fitted checkpoints remain in retained research evidence. Source hashes bind this snapshot; no live refresh is implied.
